## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-fascicle Esoteric *dhāraṇī*-ritual text attributed to **Śubhakarasiṃha** ([善無畏](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%96%84%E7%84%A1%E7%95%8F)). The title encodes the soteriological function: the three *siddhi*-attainments are achieved through *dhāraṇī*-recitation that (i) destroys the hells, (ii) transforms karmic obstructions, and (iii) transcends the three realms (kāma-, rūpa-, ārūpya-dhātu).

**Abstract**

The text presents an Esoteric *dhāraṇī*-cum-*sādhana* practice oriented to **soteriological transformation** — the *dhāraṇī*-practice as the means of breaking through the karmic conditioning of *saṃsāra* and attaining the three *siddhi* of pacification (*śāntika*), augmentation (*pauṣṭika*), and transcendence (*lokottara* / out-of-the-three-realms). The work is one of three Śubhakarasiṃha-attributed Esoteric *dhāraṇī*-rituals on this theme ([KR6j0076](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0076)–[KR6j0078](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0078)), each presenting a slightly different framework.

The translation dates from Śubhakarasiṃha's Chángān period (716–735).
